test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: ______ was a key position in the royal court of Delhi sultanate and his role was of a general supervisor over all departments.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Diwan-i-Wizarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Diwan-I-Wizarat** was a key position in the royal court and his role was of a** general supervisor over all departments**.
 
• The main functions of the wazir were to look after the **financial organization of the State **and on occasion to lead **military expeditions.​**​
